title: Phyllis Schlemmer channels the Nine: Earth as a bottleneck of consciousness
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Phyllis Schlemmer channels the Nine: Earth as a bottleneck of consciousness, about 1970s-1990s at Earth, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And Phyllis Schlemmer who later wrote The Only Planet of Choice, which channels the nine, I think she talks about the nine with respect to messages around the Earth being a bottleneck of consciousness, right?
